items.title: COP17: What happened at this year’s desertification summit?
items.summary: Today (28 August) marks the end of the seventeenth Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD COP17).

items.title: UK faces £190m in excess weekly energy bills due to Iran war
items.summary: New analysis by the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU) has found that for every week the conflict continues, a further £190m in excess costs is added to energy bills.

items.title: ‘The biggest investment is time’: Navigating B Corp’s toughest-ever standards
items.summary: In June, the first cohort of companies to certify under B Corporation's new framework were announced.

2026全球減碳浪潮下的台灣淨零現況
items.summary: 隨著全球氣候變遷加劇，各類極端氣候災害帶來的經濟與社會成本持續攀升。聯合國政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）在其核心報告中明確指出，人類活動產生的溫室氣體已造成全球平均升溫超過攝氏1度，氣候風險已不再是未來的預測，而是企業當前必須面對的實質成本。

items.title: Deutsche Bank Backs Squadron Energy With $115M
items.summary: Deutsche Bank has committed approximately $115 million to a refinancing package for Squadron Energy, expanding its backing of renewable energy infrastructure in Australia.

items.title: Trump Policies Could Cut 540 GW of U.S. Clean Power: NRDC Says
items.summary: The Trump administration’s energy policies could prevent between 390 GW and 540 GW of new U.S. wind, solar and energy storage capacity from being built over the next decade, according to projections from the Natural Resources Defense Council.

items.title: Ben & Jerry’s Appoints Three Directors to Strengthen Social Mission
items.summary: Ben & Jerry’s has appointed three independent directors as it moves to strengthen oversight of its social mission after years of conflict with its corporate owners.

items.title: Voltalia Wins Approval for $35B Brazil Data Center
items.summary: Brazil has approved French renewable energy company Voltalia’s planned $35.24 billion data center development in Ceará, clearing a major regulatory hurdle for one of the country’s largest digital infrastructure projects.
